subject.title: fix(clickclack): deliver media and configurable model replies [AI-assisted]

question: Should existing ClickClack model-mode accounts automatically move from a 96-token reply budget to 512 tokens, or should 512 remain an explicit per-account opt-in?
rationale: The code can support either policy, but the default determines upgrade-time latency, cost, reply length, and whether current users receive changed behavior without editing configuration.

options.title: Preserve the 96-token default
options.body: Add maxTokens as an opt-in setting while retaining current upgrade behavior until broader live evidence supports a default change.

options.title: Approve 512 as the new default
options.body: Accept the increased budget after adding live before-and-after model evidence and clearly documenting the upgrade-time cost and latency change.

options.title: Split the changes
options.body: Land the independently proven media fix now and review configurable model budgets and their default in a separate PR.

recommendation.title: Preserve the 96-token default
recommendation.body: Add maxTokens as an opt-in setting while retaining current upgrade behavior until broader live evidence supports a default change.
